product.title: Cortech Summit Veldura Soft-Touch Durable Accent Chair - 311
product.body_html:
The Cortech Summit Accent Chair for individual and group seating with Veldura soft-touch exterior combines ergonomic comfort with molded durability for behavioral health. Calming design, safe edges, and easy cleanability for high-use spaces. Designed to stand alone or be arranged in groups.

  • Durable, one piece, rotationally molded design for maximum strength. Constructed of high impact “no break” polyethylene. No steel or wood components
  • Veldura soft-touch exterior
  • Residential-inspired form for therapeutic environments
  • Rounded edges and smooth surfaces enhance safety
  • Options:
    • Available in Standard version without Veldura soft-touch exterior (order style 310)
    • Model 311S has a ballast door that secures with tamper-resistant screws and can be used to add sandbags on-site (loose sand not recommended)
    • Factory weighting available
  • Inherently antimicrobial and easy to clean
  • Sound dampening
  • One-piece molded frame with no metal or wood components
  • Dimensions: 29"H x 27"W x 29"D
  • Flame retardant (passes UL 94 HB)
  • GREENGUARD Gold Certified for low chemical emissions
  • Lifetime Warranty.
  • Made in the USA to ISO Quality Standards.
  • Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, Tide

The Cortech Summit Veldura Accent Chair blends residential comfort with the durability required for behavioral health and other secure environments. Its softened silhouette, rounded edges, and warm visual profile help create a calming atmosphere that supports therapeutic goals. Because of its balanced proportions, the Cortech Summit Accent Chair works well in patient rooms, group areas, dayrooms, and visitor spaces.

The Summit Accent Chair's molded polyethylene frame eliminates seams and joints that could be tampered with, while the available Veldura soft-touch surface provides a comforting tactile experience. The Summit chair’s design reduces opportunities for misuse but still offers a familiar, approachable aesthetic. In addition, the Summit chair can be factory weighted or filled on site using approved material. Loose sand should not be used. This added mass improves stability in high-use behavioral health settings.

The Summit Accent Chair coordinates with other Summit seating and tables, allowing facilities to create cohesive, human-centered environments. Its cleanability, strength, and calming design make it a dependable choice for spaces that support healing and safety.

About Cortech Summit Furniture:
The Cortech Summit Series intense use furniture line is ideal for use as behavioral health furniture and Behavioral Healthcare mental health furniture. The Cortech Summit Furniture Series is also a perfect fit for residential institutions, public safety facilities and any intense or high abuse applications such as drug and alcohol rehabilitation centers and addiction treatment centers.

About the Cortech Veldura Finish:
The Summit Series' Veldura finish provides the user with a soft and calming seat solution. Cortech accomplishes this exceptional feel without compromising durability or cleaning. The Veldura finish also provides a visual contrast between the seating surface area and the seat base.

About Cortech USA:
Cortech USA (Correctional Technologies) manufactures products that are exceptionally durable, designed for use in compassionate and normative behavioral healthcare, corrections, law enforcement, heavy use commercial and industrial environments, parks and recreation, schools, universities, hospitals, emergency and homeless shelters, and other institutions and facilities where safety and durability matter. Cortech products are ideal for extreme use and intensive use environments.
